overview_description.description: Kimpton AI provides an AI-native investment research platform for portfolio managers and other buy-side investors. The platform connects to brokerage and portfolio systems to ingest holdings, P&L, and cost basis, then generates structured daily trade proposals tailored to each book and mandate. Users can upload mandates, theses, research PDFs, and sector models into a vault that is referenced in every analysis. Kimpton AI also offers deep research cited to SEC filings, earnings transcripts, estimates, and market data, along with configurable dashboards, charting and backtesting tools, and scheduled skills for recurring workflows. Reporting features produce performance attribution, investor letters, and sector or thesis deep dives aligned to the portfolio. The system runs as a web-based terminal where AI agents perform research and surface proposals while the portfolio manager retains all trade decisions.
